_note: Pre-determined text an operator can merge into a SITREP section with the + button. Draft placeholder library for Beacon, informed by recurring themes in publicly available NSW SES operational updates, including warnings, weather and flood intelligence, incident statistics, community impacts, road access, isolation, resupply, multi-agency operations, resource deployment, operational priorities, prognosis and safety messaging. Operators must verify and edit all inserted text against current intelligence before publishing.

situation.label: Severe weather warning current
situation.text: A Severe Weather Warning is current for [forecast district/location] for [heavy rainfall/damaging winds/destructive winds/large hail/damaging surf]. Conditions remain dynamic and are being monitored.

situation.label: Flood watch current
situation.text: A Flood Watch is current for [catchment/river system]. Forecast rainfall may produce river rises and [minor/moderate/major] flooding.

situation.label: Flood warning current
situation.text: A [minor/moderate/major] Flood Warning is current for [river/location]. The river is [rising/steady/falling] and is expected to reach approximately [height] metres at [time/date].

situation.label: Warnings issued
situation.text: NSW SES has issued [number] warning(s) for communities in [locations], including [Advice/Watch and Act/Emergency Warning] messages relating to [hazard/action].

situation.label: Incident remains active
situation.text: The event remains active across [operational area]. NSW SES and partner agencies continue to respond to requests for assistance and monitor changing conditions.

situation.label: Flash flooding risk
situation.text: Heavy rainfall may lead to flash flooding in [location], particularly across low-lying areas, roads, causeways and rapidly responding catchments.

situation.label: Catchments saturated
situation.text: Catchments in the affected area are saturated. Further rainfall may result in rapid runoff, renewed river rises and additional access impacts.

situation.label: Storm impacts occurring
situation.text: Storm activity is producing [fallen trees/roof damage/water ingress/downed powerlines] across [location]. The volume of requests for assistance is [increasing/stable/decreasing].

situation.label: Situation stable
situation.text: The situation is currently stable. No significant escalation has been identified, although forecast conditions and incoming intelligence may alter the risk profile.

situation.label: Operational statistics
situation.text: During the reporting period, NSW SES recorded [number] calls, [number] incidents and [number] flood rescues. [Number] incidents remain outstanding.

situation.label: Geographic focus
situation.text: The main areas of operational activity are [locations/zones], with the highest demand currently occurring in [location].

situation.label: Situation improving
situation.text: Weather conditions and incident demand are easing across [location]. Residual flooding, damaged infrastructure and outstanding tasks will continue to require monitoring.

impact.label: Road closures and access
impact.text: Multiple local roads, bridges and causeways are closed or affected by [floodwater/debris/fallen trees/snow]. Access to [communities/facilities] is restricted.

impact.label: Community isolation
impact.text: Residents and properties in [location] are isolated or at risk of isolation due to flood-affected roads and river crossings.

impact.label: Extended isolation possible
impact.text: Some communities may experience isolation for approximately [duration]. Essential supply and welfare requirements are being assessed.

impact.label: Property damage
impact.text: Damage has been reported to [homes/businesses/outbuildings/vehicles] from [wind/floodwater/fallen trees]. Impact assessment is continuing.

impact.label: Water entering properties
impact.text: Water ingress has been reported at properties in [location]. Crews are undertaking temporary repairs, pumping and other priority tasks where safe and practicable.

impact.label: Fallen trees and powerlines
impact.text: Fallen trees and downed powerlines are affecting roads, properties and local infrastructure. Relevant asset owners have been notified.

impact.label: Critical infrastructure
impact.text: Potential or confirmed impacts to [power/water/telecommunications/health/transport] infrastructure are being assessed with the responsible agency or provider.

impact.label: Evacuations
impact.text: Residents in [location] have been advised to [prepare to evacuate/evacuate now]. An evacuation centre is [open/planned/not required] at [location].

impact.label: Flood rescues
impact.text: Crews have completed [number] flood rescue(s), primarily involving [vehicles/persons/animals] affected by floodwater in [location].

impact.label: Agricultural impacts
impact.text: Impacts to primary producers include [isolated livestock/damaged fencing/crop inundation/disrupted access]. Requests are being coordinated with relevant support agencies.

impact.label: Community disruption
impact.text: The event is disrupting local travel, schools, businesses and community services across [location].

impact.label: No significant impacts
impact.text: No significant impacts to life, property or critical infrastructure have been confirmed during this reporting period.

resources.label: Local units deployed
resources.text: NSW SES units from [locations] are deployed to priority incidents and are being supported by neighbouring units as required.

resources.label: Personnel deployed
resources.text: Approximately [number] NSW SES personnel are supporting operations across [location/zone/state].

resources.label: Multi-agency response
resources.text: NSW SES is coordinating with [NSW Police Force/Fire and Rescue NSW/NSW Rural Fire Service/Ambulance NSW/Transport for NSW/local council/other] in support of incident objectives.

resources.label: Flood rescue capability
resources.text: Flood rescue teams, including [in-water operators/boats/high-clearance vehicles], are positioned in or moving to identified risk areas.

resources.label: Aviation assets
resources.text: Aviation assets are [deployed/on standby/requested] for [reconnaissance/rescue/resupply/personnel movement] in [location].

resources.label: Specialist resources
resources.text: Specialist capability has been assigned for [storm damage/flood rescue/communications/logistics/intelligence/impact assessment].

resources.label: Additional resources requested
resources.text: Additional [personnel/vehicles/boats/aviation/logistics/communications] resources have been requested for the next operational period.

resources.label: Resources adequate
resources.text: Current resources are assessed as adequate for planned operations. Demand and resource availability will continue to be reviewed.

resources.label: Resource shortfall
resources.text: A potential shortfall exists in [capability/location/time period]. Mitigation includes [task reprioritisation/mutual aid/pre-positioning/additional request].

resources.label: Resupply capability
resources.text: Boat, high-clearance vehicle and/or aviation capability is available to support essential resupply to isolated communities, subject to conditions.

resources.label: Incident management staffing
resources.text: Incident management arrangements are operating at [unit/zone/state] level, with functional roles staffed for the current operational period.

resources.label: Relief and rotation
resources.text: Relief crews and shift rotations are being planned to maintain operational coverage and manage fatigue.

execution.label: Life safety priority
execution.text: Operational priorities are life safety, timely warnings, protection of property and critical infrastructure, and support to isolated communities.

execution.label: Respond to priority incidents
execution.text: Crews are prioritising incidents involving immediate threats to life, flood rescue, evacuation, structural hazards and critical access routes.

execution.label: Community warnings
execution.text: Warnings and public information are being issued and reviewed as intelligence changes. Messaging is being distributed through approved channels.

execution.label: Evacuation operations
execution.text: Evacuation planning and support are underway for [location], including route assessment, transport arrangements and welfare coordination.

execution.label: Damage assessment
execution.text: Rapid impact and damage assessments are being conducted in [location] to identify priority needs and inform recovery planning.

execution.label: Storm damage operations
execution.text: Crews are undertaking temporary repairs, tree removal and access restoration, with tasks prioritised by risk and community consequence.

execution.label: Flood rescue posture
execution.text: Flood rescue teams are pre-positioned at [location] and will maintain readiness during the forecast high-risk period.

execution.label: Reconnaissance and intelligence
execution.text: Ground and/or aerial reconnaissance is being used to confirm impacts, access constraints, river behaviour and community needs.

execution.label: Resupply isolated communities
execution.text: Essential food, water, medicines and other critical items are being coordinated for isolated residents in [location].

execution.label: Clear outstanding incidents
execution.text: Operations are focused on reducing the outstanding incident queue while retaining capacity for new priority requests.

execution.label: Protect critical infrastructure
execution.text: Protective actions are being coordinated for [asset/location], including access, temporary works and liaison with the asset owner.

execution.label: Next operational period
execution.text: Planning for the next operational period includes [resource rotation/pre-positioning/intelligence collection/community messaging/recovery transition].

emergingIssues.label: Further severe weather
emergingIssues.text: Forecast [rainfall/wind/thunderstorm/surf/snow] may increase incident demand and create additional impacts during [time period].

emergingIssues.label: Renewed river rises
emergingIssues.text: Further rainfall over saturated catchments may cause renewed river rises and extend or worsen flooding in [location].

emergingIssues.label: Flash flooding escalation
emergingIssues.text: Short-duration intense rainfall may produce rapid flash flooding before formal river warnings can be issued.

emergingIssues.label: Access deterioration
emergingIssues.text: Additional road closures may restrict crew access, evacuation routes, community movement and resupply operations.

emergingIssues.label: Prolonged isolation
emergingIssues.text: Extended isolation may create increasing demand for food, medicines, fuel, animal welfare and other essential support.

emergingIssues.label: Outstanding incident backlog
emergingIssues.text: A sustained volume of new incidents may delay completion of lower-priority tasks and increase the outstanding workload.

emergingIssues.label: Resource fatigue
emergingIssues.text: Extended operations and travel requirements are increasing fatigue risk. Relief, rotation and accommodation arrangements require ongoing attention.

emergingIssues.label: Resource competition
emergingIssues.text: Concurrent incidents across multiple locations may place pressure on specialist resources, aviation assets and incident management personnel.

emergingIssues.label: Communications limitations
emergingIssues.text: Communications coverage or network congestion may affect field reporting and coordination in [location].

emergingIssues.label: Critical infrastructure risk
emergingIssues.text: Flooding or storm damage may affect [power/water/telecommunications/transport/health] infrastructure and create cascading community impacts.

emergingIssues.label: Community complacency
emergingIssues.text: Repeated warnings or easing local conditions may reduce community responsiveness despite continuing flood, road and structural hazards.

emergingIssues.label: Media and public information demand
emergingIssues.text: Media interest and community information demand are increasing. Coordinated, timely and consistent messaging will be required.

prognosis.label: Conditions easing
prognosis.text: Weather conditions are forecast to ease from [time/date]. Incident demand should gradually reduce, although residual hazards and cleanup tasks will continue.

prognosis.label: Further rainfall forecast
prognosis.text: Further rainfall of approximately [range] mm is forecast over [period], with isolated higher totals possible. Additional flash flooding and river rises remain possible.

prognosis.label: Flooding to persist
prognosis.text: Riverine flooding and access impacts are expected to persist for [duration] as water moves through the catchment.

prognosis.label: Incident demand increasing
prognosis.text: Incident demand is expected to increase during [period] as forecast conditions affect [location].

prognosis.label: Incident demand stabilising
prognosis.text: Incident demand is expected to stabilise during the next operational period, subject to forecast conditions.

prognosis.label: Escalation possible
prognosis.text: Escalation remains possible if forecast rainfall exceeds expectations, warnings are upgraded or critical access routes are lost.

prognosis.label: Resource posture maintained
prognosis.text: The current resource posture should be maintained for at least [duration], with a review at [time/date].

prognosis.label: Resource drawdown
prognosis.text: A staged resource drawdown may commence from [time/date] if incident demand, weather and warning levels continue to reduce.

prognosis.label: Extended operations
prognosis.text: Operations are likely to continue for [duration] due to [prolonged flooding/isolation/outstanding storm damage/cleanup requirements].

prognosis.label: Transition to recovery
prognosis.text: Transition to recovery is expected to commence in [location/timeframe], while response operations continue for residual risks and priority requests.

prognosis.label: No significant change
prognosis.text: No significant change is expected during the next reporting period. Current objectives and resource levels remain appropriate.

prognosis.label: Next review trigger
prognosis.text: The prognosis will be reviewed following [next forecast/warning update/river peak/operational briefing] or any significant change in conditions.

safety.label: Do not enter floodwater
safety.text: Personnel and the public must not drive, walk or play in floodwater. Use an alternate route and comply with road closures and warning signage.

safety.label: Rapid flash flooding
safety.text: Flash flooding can occur quickly and without warning. Monitor rainfall, identify escape routes and avoid low-lying roads, causeways, creeks and drains.

safety.label: Floodwater contamination
safety.text: Floodwater may contain sewage, chemicals, debris, unstable surfaces and biological hazards. Apply appropriate PPE, hygiene and decontamination controls.

safety.label: Fallen trees and branches
safety.text: Maintain exclusion zones around unstable trees, hanging branches and storm-damaged vegetation. Reassess hazards as wind and ground conditions change.

safety.label: Downed powerlines
safety.text: Treat all fallen or damaged electrical infrastructure as energised. Maintain a safe distance and notify the electricity network operator.

safety.label: Roadside operations
safety.text: Apply traffic management controls, high-visibility PPE, safe vehicle positioning and a dedicated lookout where crews are operating near traffic.

safety.label: Swiftwater operations
safety.text: Only appropriately trained and equipped personnel are to operate in or near swiftwater. Use approved rescue systems and maintain downstream safety controls.

safety.label: Boat operations
safety.text: Confirm vessel suitability, crew competency, communications, flotation equipment, navigation hazards and weather limitations before boat operations.

safety.label: Fatigue management
safety.text: Supervisors are to monitor work hours, travel, rest breaks and fitness for task. Rotate crews and stand down personnel where fatigue may impair safety.

safety.label: Heat, cold and hydration
safety.text: Monitor personnel for heat or cold stress. Provide suitable PPE, hydration, nutrition, shelter and scheduled rest breaks.

safety.label: Slips, trips and manual handling
safety.text: Use appropriate lighting, footwear, team lifting and mechanical aids. Take care on wet, muddy, uneven or debris-covered surfaces.

safety.label: Dynamic risk assessment
safety.text: Complete and continually review dynamic risk assessments. Pause or withdraw if conditions exceed capability, controls are ineffective or communications are lost.

safety.label: Welfare and psychological safety
safety.text: Monitor personnel welfare following prolonged, high-risk or distressing tasks. Escalate welfare concerns and provide access to peer or professional support.

safety.label: Hazard and near-miss reporting
safety.text: Report hazards, injuries, exposures and near misses promptly through established command and safety reporting channels.
